failure_definition: Optical heart rate sensor calibration drift during exercise
causal_mechanism: Motion artifacts (e.g., arm movement, muscle contractions) corrupting the photoplethysmographic signal
current_device_behavior: The baseline PPG sensor includes motion compensation, but it is not effective enough to prevent calibration drift during exercise
blocking_constraint: The need for a solution that is both accurate and power-efficient, as well as the requirement for a low-cost and compact design
